name: Aldrich Arena Farmers' Market
tagline: Costa Produce Farm – Saint Paul Farmers' Market
description: Aldrich Arena Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 1850 White Bear Ave, MN. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
